summary: Defines generic matching rules that can match any attribute in LDAP or X.500 directories, even those with complex structured syntax. Matching rules defined for complex syntaxes usually only offer the most immediately useful matching, and this broadens that. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Looking things up in a directory is easy for simple words but hard for complicated entries. This gives a general way to compare any part of a complicated entry.

questions: how to match parts of complex ldap attributes
